notes:
High-level: Meridian DevMesh is an internal developer tooling company (code hosting + search) evaluating Redwood for a global RAG/code-search platform. They run a very large embedding corpus (~50M vectors across repos, private packages, and generated artifacts). Priority is p95 latency for code path + cost per query; security is hard requirement (SSO/SAML + SCIM + audit logs).

Key quotes from AE/SE call:
- "We need rerankers that hit <150ms p95 end-to-end for code search (embedding retrieval + dense rerank)."
- "Daily re-index is non-negotiable; partial/incremental updates are required — re-embedding 50M vectors nightly is too expensive."
- "Cannot allow customer code or secrets to leave our VPC or be logged in hosted systems."

Technical requirements/constraints (customer-provided):
- Corpus: ~50M vectors, avg vector size 768-1536 dim depending on model; many small documents (code snippets, functions) plus README/PR text.
- QPS targets: baseline 150 qps, peak 400 qps during developer hours; p50 target 20ms, p95 target <150ms for combined ANN retrieval + reranker.
- Cost target: <= $0.02 per interactive query (end-to-end) at scale; willing to trade ~10% latency for 20% cost savings.
- Re-index cadence: incremental daily delta ingestion; full rebuild acceptable weekly during low-traffic windows. Need API for partial upserts + background re-embedding jobs.
- Reranking approach: hybrid sparse retrieval (BM25) + dense ANN candidate fetch (HNSW/IVF) -> transformer-based re-ranker for top-50. POC wants both Redis-like sparse fallback and dense-first flow.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-verified code embeddings (code-embed-384) or customer-trained models; prefer ability to pin models and route to cheaper variants for lower-priority routes.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM + attribute-based access controls by team, KMS integration for envelope encryption, SOC2/ISO compliance proofs, long-term audit logs (1 year).
